condition.en: Compare direct EAI and CAI_M on the same task set using relay fidelity, correction rounds, and intent loss rate.
condition.zh: 用同一组任务比较 direct EAI 与 CAI_M 的 relay fidelity、返工次数和意图丢失率。

description.en: Under the same task, context, and token budget, adding a structured CAI middle layer will produce higher intent relay fidelity than a direct EAI path and require fewer correction rounds.
description.zh: 在同一任务、同一上下文和同一 token 预算下，加入结构化 CAI 中间层后，意图中继保真度将高于直接 EAI 路径，且返工轮次更少。

future_observation.en: Under the same task, context, and token budget, adding a structured CAI middle layer will produce higher intent relay fidelity than a direct EAI path and require fewer correction rounds.
future_observation.zh: 在同一任务、同一上下文和同一 token 预算下，加入结构化 CAI 中间层后，意图中继保真度将高于直接 EAI 路径，且返工轮次更少。

name: CAI 中间层会持续提高意图中继保真度
name_en: CAI middle layer will keep improving intent relay fidelity

verification_method.en: Compare direct EAI and CAI_M on the same task set using relay fidelity, correction rounds, and intent loss rate.
verification_method.zh: 用同一组任务比较 direct EAI 与 CAI_M 的 relay fidelity、返工次数和意图丢失率。

condition.en: Run an A/B test with natural-language prompts and API-style prompts on the same task group, then compare success rate, correction rounds, and semantic fidelity.
condition.zh: 对同一任务组做自然语言提示与 API 风格提示 A/B 对照，比较成功率、返工轮次和语义保真度。

description.en: When the token window is tight, structured API-style prompts will improve execution success but lower semantic fidelity; with enough tokens, the fidelity gap will shrink.
description.zh: 当 token 窗口紧张时，结构化 API 风格提示会提高执行成功率，但会压低语义保真度；如果 token 充足，保真度差距会缩小。

future_observation.en: When the token window is tight, structured API-style prompts will improve execution success but lower semantic fidelity; with enough tokens, the fidelity gap will shrink.
future_observation.zh: 当 token 窗口紧张时，结构化 API 风格提示会提高执行成功率，但会压低语义保真度；如果 token 充足，保真度差距会缩小。

name: 结构化 API 提示在 token 紧张时更准但更窄
name_en: Structured API prompts will be narrower but more accurate under token pressure

verification_method.en: Run an A/B test with natural-language prompts and API-style prompts on the same task group, then compare success rate, correction rounds, and semantic fidelity.
verification_method.zh: 对同一任务组做自然语言提示与 API 风格提示 A/B 对照，比较成功率、返工轮次和语义保真度。

condition.en: Compare a reform scenario with only economic subsidy against one that also lowers identity/social exit costs, and measure adoption, retention, and rebound rate.
condition.zh: 比较仅有经济补贴与同时降低身份/社会退出成本的两个改革场景，记录采用率、留存率和反弹率。

description.en: In reform or adoption settings, lowering economic cost alone will not materially change adoption speed; only when identity and social exit costs fall will the system move into Step 5 or near it.
description.zh: 在改革或新系统采纳场景里，单纯降低经济成本不会显著改变采纳速度；只有身份和社会退出成本下降时，系统才会明显进入第 5 步或接近第 5 步。

future_observation.en: In reform or adoption settings, lowering economic cost alone will not materially change adoption speed; only when identity and social exit costs fall will the system move into Step 5 or near it.
future_observation.zh: 在改革或新系统采纳场景里，单纯降低经济成本不会显著改变采纳速度；只有身份和社会退出成本下降时，系统才会明显进入第 5 步或接近第 5 步。

name: 身份与社会退出成本比单纯经济补贴更能推动制度采纳
name_en: Identity and social exit costs will matter more than economic subsidies for adoption

verification_method.en: Compare a reform scenario with only economic subsidy against one that also lowers identity/social exit costs, and measure adoption, retention, and rebound rate.
verification_method.zh: 比较仅有经济补贴与同时降低身份/社会退出成本的两个改革场景，记录采用率、留存率和反弹率。

condition.en: Observe new reform cases and record whether local exit channels appear before the stable institution does.
condition.zh: 观察新出现的改革案例，记录是否先出现局部退出通道，再出现稳态制度。

description.en: When an old regime loosens, the first signs will not be a complete new order but partial exit channels, temporary coordination mechanisms, and short-lived hybrid identities; durable transition will come later.
description.zh: 当旧制度出现松动时，最先出现的不是完整新秩序，而是部分退出通道、临时协调机制与短命的中间型认同；真正稳定的转型会晚于这些结构。

future_observation.en: When an old regime loosens, the first signs will not be a complete new order but partial exit channels, temporary coordination mechanisms, and short-lived hybrid identities; durable transition will come later.
future_observation.zh: 当旧制度出现松动时，最先出现的不是完整新秩序，而是部分退出通道、临时协调机制与短命的中间型认同；真正稳定的转型会晚于这些结构。

name: 部分退出通道会先于稳定制度转型出现
name_en: Partial exit channels will appear before durable institutional transition

verification_method.en: Observe new reform cases and record whether local exit channels appear before the stable institution does.
verification_method.zh: 观察新出现的改革案例，记录是否先出现局部退出通道，再出现稳态制度。

condition.en: Run repeated-feedback experiments on high-uncertainty tasks and observe whether decision tracks remain tri-track or higher.
condition.zh: 对高不确定任务做重复反馈实验，观察决策轨道是否维持三轨以上。

description.en: In high-uncertainty environments where feedback remains informative, the system will preserve tri-track or multi-track decision structure longer than expected; collapse to two-track or single-track typically happens only after feedback is cut off.
description.zh: 在不确定性高但反馈仍然有效的环境里，系统会比预期更久地保留三轨或多轨决策结构；真正坍缩为二轨或单轨，通常发生在反馈被切断之后。

future_observation.en: In high-uncertainty environments where feedback remains informative, the system will preserve tri-track or multi-track decision structure longer than expected; collapse to two-track or single-track typically happens only after feedback is cut off.
future_observation.zh: 在不确定性高但反馈仍然有效的环境里，系统会比预期更久地保留三轨或多轨决策结构；真正坍缩为二轨或单轨，通常发生在反馈被切断之后。

name: 高不确定下的决策系统会更久保留三轨结构
name_en: Decision systems under high uncertainty will retain tri-track structure longer

verification_method.en: Run repeated-feedback experiments on high-uncertainty tasks and observe whether decision tracks remain tri-track or higher.
verification_method.zh: 对高不确定任务做重复反馈实验，观察决策轨道是否维持三轨以上。

condition.en: Compare staged investment and lump-sum investment across future market cycles using drawdown-adjusted returns.
condition.zh: 用未来几个市场周期比较分批投入与一次性投入在回撤调整后收益上的差异。

description.en: Across market windows with repeated regime shifts, the conservative incremental-investment family will continue to beat lump-sum allocation on drawdown-adjusted results, and the advantage will grow as regime shifts become more frequent.
description.zh: 在多次 regime shift 的市场窗口里，保守的分批投入族会在回撤调整后的结果上继续优于一次性重仓；当 regime shift 越频繁时，这种优势越明显。

future_observation.en: Across market windows with repeated regime shifts, the conservative incremental-investment family will continue to beat lump-sum allocation on drawdown-adjusted results, and the advantage will grow as regime shifts become more frequent.
future_observation.zh: 在多次 regime shift 的市场窗口里，保守的分批投入族会在回撤调整后的结果上继续优于一次性重仓；当 regime shift 越频繁时，这种优势越明显。

name: 分批投入在多次 regime shift 中会比一次性投入更稳
name_en: Incremental investing will stay more robust than lump-sum investing across regime shifts

verification_method.en: Compare staged investment and lump-sum investment across future market cycles using drawdown-adjusted returns.
verification_method.zh: 用未来几个市场周期比较分批投入与一次性投入在回撤调整后收益上的差异。

condition.en: Cross-validate a single-gate model and a multi-gate model on future cases and compare accuracy and interpretability.
condition.zh: 用未来的新案例对单门控与多门控模型做交叉验证，比较精度和可解释性。

description.en: When a model tries to cover physical, systems, cognitive, and engineering problems at once, the generalization accuracy of a single gate function will drop; splitting the problem into two or more gate families will produce more stable predictions.
description.zh: 当模型尝试同时覆盖物理、系统、认知和工程问题时，单一门控函数的泛化精度会下降；把问题拆成两类或更多门控族后，预测会更稳定。

future_observation.en: When a model tries to cover physical, systems, cognitive, and engineering problems at once, the generalization accuracy of a single gate function will drop; splitting the problem into two or more gate families will produce more stable predictions.
future_observation.zh: 当模型尝试同时覆盖物理、系统、认知和工程问题时，单一门控函数的泛化精度会下降；把问题拆成两类或更多门控族后，预测会更稳定。

name: 跨领域门控问题会逼迫模型拆成多种门控族
name_en: Cross-domain gate problems will force models to split into multiple gate families

verification_method.en: Cross-validate a single-gate model and a multi-gate model on future cases and compare accuracy and interpretability.
verification_method.zh: 用未来的新案例对单门控与多门控模型做交叉验证，比较精度和可解释性。

condition.en: Apply the same prediction-error stream to systems with and without explicit feedback loops, then compare self-model stability and correction speed.
condition.zh: 对有无显式 feedback loop 的系统分别施加同一批预测误差，比较自我模型稳定度和纠错速度。

description.en: When a system writes prediction error back into its state space, it will not merely predict better; it will more readily develop self-modeling, self-correction, and more stable multi-track awareness.
description.zh: 当系统把 prediction error 直接写回状态空间时，它不再只是“预测得更准”，而会更容易出现自我模型、自我纠错和更稳定的多轨意识结构。

future_observation.en: When a system writes prediction error back into its state space, it will not merely predict better; it will more readily develop self-modeling, self-correction, and more stable multi-track awareness.
future_observation.zh: 当系统把 prediction error 直接写回状态空间时，它不再只是“预测得更准”，而会更容易出现自我模型、自我纠错和更稳定的多轨意识结构。

name: 显式反馈回路会把预测误差转成更高层意识信号
name_en: Explicit feedback loops will convert prediction error into higher-order awareness signals

verification_method.en: Apply the same prediction-error stream to systems with and without explicit feedback loops, then compare self-model stability and correction speed.
verification_method.zh: 对有无显式 feedback loop 的系统分别施加同一批预测误差，比较自我模型稳定度和纠错速度。
